name: Jin Grandet
source:
The mature first prince is reliable... and quite the lady killer. But even though he flirts with you, he's made a promise to himself that he plans to keep. That promise? Never to fall in love with Belle. 

"I won't become king. I'm outta this race. But I'll watch over the fate you decide." 

[From in-game profile]
